topics.topic: Steroids in pneumonia

source.title: Systemic corticosteroids in critical illness: an evidence-based framework for clinical decision-making
source.whyItFits: Open review that synthesises corticosteroid evidence in severe community-acquired pneumonia, including the CAPE COD hydrocortisone trial and the advice against routine steroids in influenza-associated ARDS. The 2019 ATS/IDSA CAP guideline is also in PMC but predates CAPE COD and recommends against routine steroids; it was not used as the teaching source.

notes: Rejected the stored 2025 CAP update abstract: it states that steroids may be used in severe CAP and not in non-severe CAP, but it is a short summary and does not carry trial figures. Rejected COVID-19 hydrocortisone papers as a different disease.

topics.topic: Thoracic Ultrasound

source.title: Lung ultrasound in the critically ill
source.whyItFits: Open review of the core thoracic ultrasound signs used at the bedside: A-lines, lung sliding, B-lines, effusion signs, and consolidation signs. The often-cited Volpicelli international recommendations are not in PMC.

notes: The BLUE-protocol paper's PMC record returned only a short file and was not used. Volpicelli 2012 is not in PMC.

topics.topic: Tracheobronchomalacia

source.title: Tracheomalacia and Tracheobronchomalacia in Pediatrics: An Overview of Evaluation, Medical Management, and Surgical Treatment
source.whyItFits: Open review of tracheomalacia and tracheobronchomalacia covering dynamic collapse, bronchoscopy as the diagnostic reference, and the commonly used >50% narrowing threshold. No comparable adult full text was in PMC. The scope is paediatric.

notes: Adult in-depth reviews suggested by the spreadsheet were not in PMC as full text.

topics.topic: Upper Airway Resistance Syndrome

source.title: Treatment of upper airway resistance syndrome in adults: Where do we stand?
source.whyItFits: Open adult review of UARS that states the diagnostic criterion is not settled, records the heterogeneous polysomnographic thresholds used in treatment studies, and summarises CPAP, oral appliances, and surgery.

notes: The Pes excerpt in the source has a space inside mmH2O from XML flattening; the stored source.txt is the text that was checked.

topics.topic: V/Q Mismatch and pulmonary gas exchange

source.title: Lung Structure and the Intrinsic Challenges of Gas Exchange
source.whyItFits: Open physiology review that explains ventilation-perfusion matching, the acinus as the gas-exchange unit, and how hypoxic pulmonary vasoconstriction preserves matching. The classic Petersson and Glenny ERJ review is not in PMC. West-zone numbers and a 0.8 ratio are not stated in the passages used.

notes: Stored pulmonary-embolism gas-exchange note was 659 characters and was not accepted.

topics.topic: Vocal Cord Dysfunction

source.title: Vocal cord dysfunction/inducible laryngeal obstruction-2022 Melbourne Roundtable Report
source.whyItFits: This is the Melbourne roundtable report named in the spreadsheet, and the full text is in PMC. It states the conventional laryngoscopic definition of VCD/ILO.

topics.topic: CT head and CT pulmonary angiography: common acute findings
notes: Unresolved. A title match is not enough, and no single open text covered acute CT head findings and acute CTPA findings together.

topics.topic: Acute Gouty Arthritis

source.title: Gout: diagnosis and management (NICE NG219)
source.whyItFits: The stored question-repair library contains the NG219 recommendation text, including diagnosis, flare treatment, and urate-lowering therapy. It is long enough to support questions without adding facts from elsewhere.

notes: EULAR gout Part II and the ACP diagnosis abstract in the library are much shorter and were not needed once NG219 recommendation text was read.

topics.topic: Acute gout attack in hospital: colchicine contraindications, IV corticosteroids, IL-1 inhibition

source.title: Gout: diagnosis and management (NICE NG219)
source.whyItFits: The same stored NG219 text is the in-app source for hospital flare sequencing: when colchicine or NSAIDs cannot be used, when injectable corticosteroid is considered, and when an IL-1 inhibitor is allowed. It does not list named colchicine drug interactions or recommend intravenous corticosteroid.

notes: Specific colchicine contraindications and intravenous corticosteroids are not in the stored NG219 text, so they were not turned into answers.

topics.topic: Adult-onset Stills disease AOSD: quotidian fever, salmon rash, ferritin, IL-1 inhibition

source.title: Mechanisms, biomarkers and targets for adult-onset Still's disease
source.whyItFits: Open review of adult-onset Still's disease covering fever, the salmon-pink rash, Yamaguchi criteria, innate cytokines including IL-1, and anakinra. A stored file titled as an AOSD review contained no Still's-disease text and was rejected.

notes: The in-app file titled Adult-Onset Still's Disease contained inflammasome text and the words Still, AOSD, and adult-onset did not appear. It was rejected.

topics.topic: Antiphospholipid Syndrome

source.title: EULAR recommendations for the management of antiphospholipid syndrome in adults
source.whyItFits: The 2019 EULAR adult APS recommendations are in PMC and state aspirin, VKA targets, the rivaroxaban restriction in triple-positive patients, and obstetric combination treatment. Stored APS items were short abstracts.

topics.topic: Autoantibody panel interpretation: ANA, ENA, dsDNA, ANCA, RF, anti-CCP clinical utility

source.title: Clinical relevance of HEp-2 indirect immunofluorescent patterns: the International Consensus on ANA patterns (ICAP) perspective
source.whyItFits: Open ICAP paper on how HEp-2 IIFA titre and pattern should be interpreted and followed up. It does not cover ANCA, rheumatoid factor, or anti-CCP, so questions stay inside ANA pattern interpretation. A Brazilian HEp-2 consensus in the library was about nomenclature harmonisation and was thinner.

notes: The topic name lists ENA, dsDNA, ANCA, RF, and anti-CCP. Those assays are outside this ICAP paper. Questions do not invent their operating characteristics.

topics.topic: AA Amyloidosis secondary to chronic arthritis

source.title: Systemic AA amyloidosis: epidemiology, diagnosis, and management
source.whyItFits: Open review of systemic AA amyloidosis. It names rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, and chronic juvenile arthritis among the inflammatory causes, and it gives the precursor protein, the Congo-red standard, SAP scintigraphy, and the proteinuria presentation.

topics.topic: Avascular Necrosis of Bone

source.title: Guidelines for clinical diagnosis and treatment of osteonecrosis of the femoral head in adults (2019 version)
source.whyItFits: Open adult ONFH guideline covering aetiology, staging, and stage-based surgical and non-surgical treatment, including core decompression. The suggested 5-year update was only an abstract on PMC.

notes: Question 5 uses a short excerpt that is present; the explanation does not add a core-decompression indication that was not checked. Core decompression occurs in the file (count 10) but the keyed point is stage-based choice.

topics.topic: Azathioprine in rheumatic disease: TPMT testing, dosing, bone marrow suppression

source.title: Clinical Pharmacogenetics Implementation Consortium Guideline for Thiopurine Dosing Based on TPMT and NUDT15 Genotypes: 2018 Update
source.whyItFits: CPIC states azathioprine dosing from TPMT and NUDT15 genotypes and the myelosuppression risk in poor metabolizers. It explicitly extrapolates pharmacokinetic dosing to non-malignant immunologic disorders, which includes rheumatic use. NICE Crohn's guidance that mentions thiopurines was rejected as the wrong disease.

topics.topic: Behcet disease: oral and genital ulcers, uveitis, pathergy, colchicine, immunosuppression

source.title: EULAR recommendations for the management of Behçet's syndrome: 2025 update
source.whyItFits: The stored abstract of the 2025 EULAR update states the overarching principles and the organ-grouped treatment recommendations, including colchicine first-line for mucocutaneous and joint disease and early monoclonal TNF inhibitors for organ-threatening disease. The 2018 full text is not in PMC. A 2026 organ-involvement systematic review was downloaded but does not state the colchicine recommendation.

notes: Pathergy and a specific uveitis drug ladder are not in the stored abstract.
